analyzed_vuln.description: The vulnerability is a stack-buffer overflow in the zbee_sec_add_key_to_keyring function. This occurs when the function attempts to copy data into the 'key_record' structure without proper bounds checking, leading to an overflow when the input key exceeds the expected length.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The overflow is triggered when dissect_zbee_aps_transport_key calls zbee_sec_add_key_to_keyring with a key that exceeds the defined ZBEE_APS_CMD_KEY_LENGTH. If this key is larger than expected, it results in writing past the allocated stack space for key_record.
